thread:
Mira: Uploaded a compact onboarding sidecar mock — slides from right, shows 3 sample templates, a short checklist, primary CTA, and a tiny "Show again" control. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/onboard/compact-sidecar :eyes:
Josh: Looks clean. Question: trap focus for first-run? If not trapping we must inert the background.
Val: Agree with Josh. If sidecar is non-modal, ensure aria-hidden/inert on the underlying content and provide SR announcement on open. Also add SR-only descriptions under each template tile.
Ana: CTA copy — current: "Create project". Suggest A/B variants: "Try a template", "Start sample", "Create project". Keep char count short for localization.
Priya: Localization flag: German strings expand ~30%. Keep labels concise and add translator notes explaining "template" context. I18nBot: Reminder: add strings to the content tracker and include description for translators.
Josh: Contrast: primary button color needs check at small sizes. If fails, darken or semibold text. Also ensure focus ring visible in high-contrast modes.
Mira: UX: should we order templates by popularity or show a "Recommended" ribbon? Last test showed order heavily affects selection.
Val: Accessibility checklist for this flow: focus order, inert background, skip link, SR tile descriptions, contrast 4.5:1, focus return to opener when closed. I'll run a screen-reader pass after updates.
Ana: Spacing nit: increase vertical gap between tile title and subtitle at narrow widths. Also clamp long names to two lines with ellipsis.
Josh: Keyboard detail: when opened via shortcut focus first actionable element and announce "Onboarding: first steps" via aria-live polite. When closed return focus to the toggler.
Mira: Action items: Mira -> update figma with SR text, spacing tweak, CTA variants. Josh -> prototype trap+inert behavior. Val -> a11y pass. Ana -> prepare CTA test plan and localization length table. Priya -> wire analytics events (sidecar_shown, template_chosen). React :thumbsup: if aligned and I'll book 20m sync Thurs.
Ana: :thumbsup:
Josh: :thumbsup:
Val: :thumbsup:

I18nBot: Don't forget context notes for translators.
